topic: A lady in white waits by the canal road at midnight and asks for a lift to a house that no longer exists.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Lift to Nowhere

shots.narration: She wanted a lift to a house swallowed by water.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated Pakistani haveli courtyard at midnight, brass lantern between two chairs, no writing anywhere.
shots.action: Bashir points toward the dark canal beyond the courtyard.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, warm lantern glow, deep shadows beneath the arches.

shots.narration: Bashir Chacha told Saad how he heard her that midnight.
shots.scene: Haveli courtyard, Bashir in his brown woollen shawl and white cap, Saad in his dark green hoodie.
shots.action: Saad leans toward Bashir's brass lantern.
shots.mood: Quiet anticipation, golden light on Bashir's grey beard.

shots.narration: [whispers] By the canal, a woman's voice called from the fog.
shots.scene: Flashback on an empty Pakistani canal road, old bicycle with a rear passenger rack, white shawl hanging from a roadside branch; no woman visible.
shots.action: Bashir stops his bicycle beside the hanging shawl.
shots.mood: Thick silver fog, black canal water, isolated lantern light.

shots.narration: She asked for the house beyond the broken waterwheel.
shots.scene: Narrow canal road beside a ruined wooden waterwheel, bicycle facing into fog.
shots.action: Bashir gestures toward the bicycle's rear rack.
shots.mood: Uneasy stillness, long wheel shadows across damp earth.

shots.narration: Something settled behind him, but he never saw her face.
shots.scene: Bicycle on the canal road, Bashir facing forward, rear rack clearly visible.
shots.action: The white shawl settles onto the rear rack without a visible wearer.
shots.mood: Pale cloth against darkness, fog hiding the empty road.

shots.narration: [sighs] At the bend, he understood why nobody visited that house.
shots.scene: Canal bend overlooking a flooded plot, ruined gateposts rising from still water.
shots.action: Bashir raises his lantern toward the submerged entrance.
shots.mood: Amber reflections across black water, broken masonry in moonlight.

shots.narration: Only its doorstep remained above the canal.
shots.scene: Flooded house foundations beyond two ruined gateposts, one stone doorstep above water, no intact building.
shots.action: A ripple washes over the lone doorstep.
shots.mood: Empty rectangular foundations, motionless fog, vast surrounding darkness.

shots.narration: Behind him, the bicycle rack was empty.
shots.scene: Canal bank beside the bicycle, bare rear rack in lantern light.
shots.action: Bashir turns toward the empty rack.
shots.mood: Sharp lantern shadows, white cap bright against the mist.

shots.narration: [whispers] Her shawl lay neatly across that flooded doorstep.
shots.scene: Isolated stone doorstep surrounded by canal water, folded white shawl resting on its dry center.
shots.action: One corner of the shawl slowly lifts.
shots.mood: Unnaturally still water, luminous cloth, darkness beneath the stone.

shots.narration: Back in the courtyard, Bashir said, 'I left it there.'
shots.scene: Present-night haveli courtyard, brass lantern between Bashir and Saad, an empty third chair beside them.
shots.action: Bashir lowers his gaze to the lantern.
shots.mood: Small warm light surrounded by cold arches and dense shadows.

shots.narration: Then the wet shawl settled onto the empty chair.
shots.scene: Haveli courtyard, empty chair beside Saad, both seated listeners visible behind it, no additional person.
shots.action: A dripping white shawl descends onto the empty chair.
shots.mood: Lantern-lit droplets, hollow folds, looming chair shadow across the floor.

shots.narration: [surprised] Then the abandoned station answered her with a whistle.
shots.scene: View through the haveli gateway toward distant railway tracks and a deserted station canopy, no signs or writing.
shots.action: Saad points his small torch toward the abandoned station.
shots.mood: Narrow torch beam, blue railway fog, one faint amber glow beneath the canopy.

episode.endHook: Next night, Bashir reveals why the abandoned railway station whistled back.
episode.description: Beside his lantern, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about an unseen woman waiting on a canal road. She wanted a lift home—but her house was already underwater. A fictional spooky tale from Midnight Watch.
